brief: 1930 Colonial Revival cottage: one and a half storeys, side-gabled with gabled dormers, a small pedimented entrance and shutters; a detached garage down the drive.

facade.notes: (Middletown OH appraisal snapshot): a 1930 two-storey stucco house with a steep front gable over an arched entry, a long driveway to a carport-garage behind; a brick Colonial and a bungalow as neighbours; sidewalk and terrace, a curbed drive apron

why.note: the late-1920s period-revival suburb: Tudor, Colonial side by side
